evidence: Commenters prefer the skill's reduced handholding and report thinking more independently; they note that a simple prompt may reproduce the effect.

evidence_sources.author: arshxyz
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've used the same model for learning before and I definitely prefer using this skill because it stops the model from the usual handholding.

evidence_sources.author: Imanari
evidence_sources.excerpt: Socratic tutoring with LLMs works great for me and I have used this skill and it also works great (can you do the same with a simple prompt? probably) Using LLMs this way was really refreshing, I could really feel how I started to think on my own again.
